events.title: Welcome Aperitivo in Trastevere
events.description: Join us for a classic Roman aperitivo! Meet fellow RoomersAround members, enjoy drinks and snacks, and explore the charming streets of Trastevere. Perfect for newcomers and regulars alike.
events.location: Freni e Frizioni, Via del Politeama 4, Trastevere

events.title: Colosseum & Roman Forum Tour
events.description: Guided tour of ancient Rome's most iconic sites. Learn about the history and architecture from a licensed guide. Skip-the-line tickets included!

events.title: Sunday Football at Villa Borghese
events.description: Casual football match in the park. All skill levels welcome! Bring water and good vibes.

events.title: Italian Cooking Class: Pasta Making
events.description: Learn to make fresh pasta from scratch! We'll prepare fettuccine and ravioli, then enjoy our creations together. All ingredients provided.
events.location: Cooking Studio, Via dei Cappellari 20, Centro

events.title: Language Exchange: Italian-English
events.description: Practice Italian and English in a relaxed café setting. Half the time in Italian, half in English. All levels welcome!

events.title: Hiking Day Trip: Castelli Romani
events.description: Escape the city! Day trip to Castelli Romani hills. Beautiful views, fresh air, and local wine tasting. Transportation included.

events.title: Live Jazz Night in Trastevere
events.description: Enjoy live jazz music at one of Rome's best venues. Great atmosphere, drinks, and company!
events.location: Big Mama, Vicolo di San Francesco a Ripa 18

events.title: Photography Walk: Hidden Rome
events.description: Explore Rome's lesser-known corners with cameras in hand. Share tips and capture unique perspectives. All camera types welcome!

events.title: Startup & Tech Networking Aperitivo
events.description: Meet entrepreneurs, developers, and innovators in Rome's tech scene. Share ideas, make connections, and discuss opportunities over drinks.

events.title: Board Games Night in Monti
events.description: Chill board games evening! We have classics and modern games. Bring your favorites too. Snacks and drinks provided.
events.location: Private apartment in Monti (address shared after registration)

events.title: Yoga in the Park - Villa Ada
events.description: Morning yoga session in beautiful Villa Ada. All levels welcome. Bring your mat and water. Donation-based.

events.title: Street Food Tour: Testaccio Market
events.description: Discover Rome's authentic street food scene! We'll taste supplì, pizza al taglio, maritozzo, and more. Foodie paradise!

events.title: Book Club: Italian Literature
events.description: Monthly book discussion. This month: 'The Name of the Rose' by Umberto Eco. Discuss in English with Italian context. Coffee provided!

events.title: Beach Cleanup - Ostia
events.description: Help keep our beaches clean! Community service event followed by a beach picnic. Gloves and bags provided. Make a difference!
events.location: Ostia Beach, Meeting at Piazza Anco Marzio

events.title: Salsa Dancing Lessons for Beginners
events.description: Learn salsa basics in a fun, social environment. No partner needed! First drink included.

events.title: Sunday Brunch & Networking
events.description: Relaxed Sunday brunch to meet new people. Great food, good conversation, and making connections in a beautiful setting.

events.title: Bike Tour: Ancient Appian Way
events.description: Cycle along the historic Via Appia Antica. See ancient ruins, aqueducts, and countryside. Bikes provided, moderate fitness level required.
events.location: Appia Antica Bike Rental, Via Appia Antica 58

events.title: Wine Tasting: Wines of Lazio
events.description: Discover the wines of the region! Guided tasting with local expert. Learn about Frascati, Cesanese, and more. Cheese pairings included.
events.location: Enoteca Provincia Romana, Via Cesare Balbo 1

events.title: Freelancers Coffee Meetup
events.description: Monthly gathering for freelancers and remote workers. Share experiences, tips, and maybe find collaborators. Casual and supportive vibe.
events.location: Faro Caffè, Via dei Piceni 8, Pigneto

events.title: Christmas Market Visit & Mulled Wine
events.description: Explore Rome's Christmas markets together! Enjoy festive atmosphere, shopping for gifts, and warming up with vin brulé.
